title: OPERADOR DE GUINDASTE
description:
Descrição

Operar equipamento de movimentação e / ou elevação de cargas do tipo guindaste, realizando

operações de carga e descarga ou no pátio atendendo solicitações de trabalhos específicos

ou programados. Operam máquinas e equipamentos de elevação, ajustando comandos, acionando

movimentos das máquinas. Avaliam condições de funcionamento das máquinas e equipamentos,

interpretando painel de instrumentos de medição, verificando fonte de alimentação,

testando comandos de acionamento. Preparam área para operação dos equipamentos e

transportam pessoas e materiais em máquinas e equipamentos de elevação. Trabalham seguindo

normas de segurança, higiene, qualidade e proteção ao meio ambiente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Zelar pelo bom estado do equipamento no que diz respeito a manutenção e boa utilização.

Elaborar o check list a fim de identificar qualquer avaria causada ao equipamento e

informar ao supervisor. Verificar se o equipamento está devidamente isolado em um raio de

operação, a fim de evitar abalroamento com outros equipamentos. Verificar a necessidade de

abastecimento do equipamento e informar ao supervisor. Verificar a capacidade de içamento

de cada equipamento e atentar-se para a operação de acordo com a carga. Içar mercadorias

dos navios, utilizando o guindaste, posicionando-as em locais apropriados do pátio ou

navio, para fins de armazenagem e posterior embarque ou desembarque. Retirar eventualmente

do pátio, as mercadorias que serão colocadas no convés do navio, usando guindaste e

colocando nas carretas a fim de encaminhar ao costado do navio e posterior recarga.

Executar rotinas de transporte de material necessários às operações no armazém, utilizando

guindaste, objetivando otimizar o tempo de processo. Cuidar da organização do espaço

físico destinado às cargas, dividindo-os no pátio e efetuando a armazenagem de forma

adequada. Posicionar materiais em local adequado através da operação de guindaste,

retirando cargas que eventualmente fiquem espalhadas, a fim de facilitar o trânsito de

veículos e outros equipamentos. Realizar eventualmente tarefas correlatas, determinadas

pela chefia imediata. Participar, diariamente, do DDS. Utilizar, corretamente, todos os

equipamentos de segurança (EPI).

É responsabilidade do operador manter o equipamento em condições de funcionalidade, sendo

responsável por tarefas complementares à manutenção, bem como inspeção e encaminhamento

para correção de eventuais defeitos e falhas observadas

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Médio CompletoCurso de Operador de Guindaste.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform .
  • Domínio em : o BigQuery o Cloud Storage (GCS) o Cloud Run o Vertex AI o Airflow / Cloud Composer
  • Vivência prática na criação, versionamento e monitoramento de DAGs.
  • Proficiência em Python e conhecimento intermediário / avançado em SQL .
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas Lakehouse.
  • Experiência com CI / CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions) .
  • Experiência com Git e boas práticas de engenharia de dados.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter DAGs no Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer.
  • Construir pipelines de dados (ETL / ELT) escaláveis e de alta performance.
  • Criar modelos, tabelas e rotinas de dados no BigQuery.
  • Implementar integrações e serviços utilizando Cloud Run ou Cloud Functions.
  • Estruturar e gerenciar camadas de dados no Google Cloud Storage.
  • Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e analytics na definição de soluções de dados.

O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares :

Carreira técnica : Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança : Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional : Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo : De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

description:
Host City Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)

Department : Government Engagement & Stakeholder Relations

Employment Type : Fixed Term - Full Time

Location : Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host City Manager will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.

Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines.

The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas.

The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities.

The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting one Host City Manager for each host city:

  • Belo Horizonte
  • Brasília
  • Fortaleza
  • Porto Alegre
  • Recife
  • Rio de Janeiro
  • Salvador
  • São Paulo

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

  • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
  • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
  • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables

  • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.
  • Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

  • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).
  • Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.
  • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance

  • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
  • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.
  • Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.
  • Reporting and Governance
  • Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.

Experience

  • Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.
  • Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).

Behavioral Competencies

  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.

Differentials

  • Familiarity with management and collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, Google Drive, WeTrack, or similar)

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independently

title: Senior Manager, Transport Finance
description:
About The Global Covenant of Mayors For Climate & Energy

The Global Covenant of Mayors for Climate and Energy (GCoM or Global Covenant), is a global coalition of cities and local governments with a shared long‑term vision of promoting and supporting voluntary action to combat climate change and move to a low‑carbon, resilient society. The alliance unites and inspires its stakeholders to strengthen global climate coherence, accelerate the energy transition, and generate locally‑tailored solutions for a common purpose: creating an inclusive, just, low‑emission, and climate‑resilient future for all.

Co‑chaired by former New York City Mayor and UN Secretary‑General’s Special Envoy for Climate Ambition and Solutions, Michael R. Bloomberg, and European Commission Executive Vice‑President for the European Green Deal, Frans Timmermans, and with the support of global and regional city networks, the Global Covenant of Mayors represents the strongest and clearest signal to national governments that cities are not only acting to stop the effects of climate change, they are leading and leading together. Mayors from across all global regions serve on the Board, and represent city networks, Regional Covenants and bring locally specific perspectives – ensuring that the Global Covenant of Mayors for Climate & Energy is truly led by mayors.

C40 Cities is the fiscal sponsor of the Bloomberg Philanthropies funded parts of the Global Covenant of Mayors (GCoM). As the host organization, C40 provides financial, administrative, and operational services to GCoM. C40 and GCoM are working closely together on aligned programmes and areas of activity.

The City Finance Programme

C40’s City Finance Programme works to address a range of municipal climate finance challenges, at different stages of project maturity, and across major urban infrastructure groups: clean energy, zero‑carbon buildings, transportation, waste and climate adaptation & resilience. By scaling up investment in these areas, and simultaneously divesting from fossil fuels, mayors are creating safer, healthier and more economically sustainable communities for the current and future residents of their cities. The team’s strategic focus is on strengthening city financial capacity, increasing the supply of climate finance and funding available to cities, facilitating engagement with finance providers, and building enabling environments that support urban climate investment. The core City Finance Programme team oversees and/or coordinates with special projects and initiatives within C40 that also have a finance focus, including ZEBRA, Laneshift, C40 Cities Finance Facility, UrbanShift, Climate Budgeting Pilot Project, and others.

The City Finance Programme’s transportation finance portfolio emphasises clean bus and freight technologies, and is expanding to additional strategic areas including walking & cycling, public transport improvement, clean air zones, vehicle charging infrastructure, and others.

C40 and GCoM Joint Activities

Bloomberg Philanthropies is supporting joint activities by C40 and the Global Covenant of Mayors (GCoM) to work with partners on a shared agenda to:

  • Increase cities’ access to finance for projects that combat the climate crisis and improve resilience;
  • Ensure nation‑states upgrade their national climate commitments as a result of working with cities, with a particular focus on city climate action being included in nation‑states’ climate action plans, which are due in 2025 (Nationally Determined Contributions or NDCs);
  • Improve the quality and ease of access to climate data so cities can start implementing the most impactful climate actions as quickly as possible.

Position Description:

The Senior Manager for Transportation Finance will hold primary responsibility for the transport finance portfolio, supporting C40 and GCoM cities in developing business models and financing options for zero emission transportation solutions. C40’s current transportation finance portfolio emphasises clean bus and freight technologies, but has potential to expand to additional strategic areas including clean air, walking & cycling, public transport improvement, vehicle charging infrastructure, transport resilience and others. With an expanding team, the position offers the opportunity to continue the development of a strong global workstream as well as provide strategic input into maximising city engagement and outcomes in a key sector for climate mitigation. The position requires a strong programme manager with technical skills related to clean transportation finance, as well as the ability to work collaboratively with C40 and GCoM programmes, donors, and partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead major areas of the Clean Transportation Finance global portfolio to support implementation of the zero emission urban transport agenda.
  • Lead a range of capacity building and city‑to‑city peer support activities to strengthen city capacity to attract and utilise funding/finance for transportation.
  • Develop and manage partnerships aimed at increasing the supply of finance available to cities, including through development of financial innovations.
  • Develop and implement existing and new strategic projects including developing project/fundraising proposals and implementation strategies.
  • Work with C40’s Transportation Team, Regional Teams and relevant GCoM teams, as well as directly with cities and transport authorities to identify and address challenges.
  • Independently manage budgets and key deliverables, including data and content for written reports, defining technical assistance support, and overseeing consultants.

Person Specification:

  • Substantial work experience related to finance and the transportation sector, with an emphasis on city finance desirable.
  • Experience working with municipalities on sustainable transport projects;
  • Diploma in Finance, Public Policy, Urban Planning, Engineering, Climate Policy, International Relations, Economy, or related fields.
  • Demonstrable project management experience, including oversight of multiple concurrent projects.
  • Strong strategic thinking capabilities coupled with an outcome, delivery‑orientated approach.
  • Strong abilities to work with others, both as a facilitator and an agenda driver with a highly collaborative approach to problem solving.
  • Experience with business case development, financial modelling and/or quantitative analysis of transportation issues desirable.
  • Ability to communicate complex content in a compelling manner, coupled with excellent convening and facilitation skills.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written), proficiency in other languages desirable.

Other Requirements:

Applicants must already have the right to work in the location they're applying for. Travel may be required as a part of the role.

We seek to recruit individuals who not only have the appropriate skills and experience for the role, but are committed to carrying out their roles in line with our organisational values.

Reporting To: Director, City Finance Programme

Term: Fixed Term Contract – until 31st December 2027 (the appointment and the duration of the role are subject to the final approval of funding)

Location: Brazil & South Africa – Please note that if your right to work in one of the listed locations is not confirmed at the time of applying, C40 will be unable to proceed with your application.

Salary : (Grade 3) Brazil (IC) USD 78,740 & South Africa ZAR 1,067,386 gross per annum – Due to its commitment to maintain equity and fairness, C40 operates on a spot salary model. This means that our employees are paid the same salary according to their grade and location.

Application Process:

Interested applicants should submit a curriculum vitae and cover letter. The closing date for receipt of applications is Wednesday, 7th January 2026 at 5pm GMT. C40 reserves the right to close this job opening before the closing date for applications so please do submit applications early.

Basic Function

This position serves as the Chief Compliance Officer, overseeing the university’s compliance program, that promotes honesty, integrity and adherence to internal policies and external regulatory requirements. The Chief Compliance Officer requires extensive experience in Compliance to effectively promote a culture of integrity, advise leadership and navigate complex University operations.

The institutional Compliance Program reinforces the University’s commitment to meeting the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and responsibility, providing independent and objective oversight of the University's compliance program to ensure that the University is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations as well as University policies.

The Chief Compliance Officer will report directly to Howard University’s Office of President and to the Board of Trustees.

Supervisory Accountability

The Chief Compliance Officer will have direct supervisory oversight of the Compliance divisions across the enterprise to include Howard University, Howard University Health Sciences and Howard University Hospital.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leads the enterprise‑wide Compliance program in accordance with the 7 Elements of an Effective Compliance Program as promulgated by the Federal Sentencing Guidelines by promoting and managing the University’s Code of Ethical Conduct, maintaining and managing the Howard University Compliance hotline and other reporting channels facilitating and overseeing campus compliance committees, advising on conflict of interest issues and leading compliance training efforts across the enterprise.
  • Serves as liaison to the Audit and Legal Committee of Howard University’s Board of Trustees, and reporting to the committee during scheduled or ad hoc meetings to keep the Board apprised of present and emerging audit and compliance issues.
  • Meets external parties on compliance topics as a representative of the University; participates in the President’s staff meetings as requested and, represents the compliance function in various standing and ad hoc University committees and departments, and meets frequently with various groups of key administrators and leaders across the enterprise to report and advise.
  • Responsible for all administrative and leadership functions for the Office of Audit and Compliance, including hiring, supervision, and other personnel decisions; managing the departmental budget and resources effectively and efficiently; maintaining a professional audit, compliance, and Title IX staff with sufficient knowledge, skills, experience, and professional certifications to meet the requirements of internal and external directives; and overseeing departmental strategic planning.

  • Experience in building, training, and developing strong audit teams of five or more professional staff.
  • Experience in operational/program analysis, quality improvement, and efficiency and effectiveness reviews is a plus. Experience with a large public university system and an understanding of a university environment and its unique characteristics.

The ability to prepare comprehensive reports and presentations, utilizing excellent verbal and written communication skills, public speaking, and training skills as well as excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Procurement Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 will support the implementation of the FIFA27 Procurement Policy, ensuring organization-wide compliance through ongoing employee training and adherence checks. You will be responsible for the creation of Purchase Orders (POs) in SAP as well as other administrative matters. You will support project leaders with RFI/RFP processes. This role drives inter-departmental alignment and manages the FIFA27 SAP cost contract database to deliver cost efficiency, compliant, simple and transparent solutions across FIFA procurement landscape.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement the FIFA27 Procurement Policy and procedures across the organization. Act as gatekeeper of the process at the relevant stages.
  • Train employees on an on-going basis to ensure adherence to FIFA27 Procurement Policy.
  • Responsible for the SAP cost contract database, including entering and maintaining contract data and creation of Purchase Orders (POs).
  • Manage (solve or forward) queries raised to the FIFA27 Procurement team mailbox.
  • Support project leaders in all matters regarding procurement including tasks such as setting up RFIs and RFPs.
  • Create spend reports for management as requested.
  • Conduct administrative activities of the procurement team.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Terciary education in Business Administration, Procurement and/or extensive experience in indirect procurement.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Consultor Oracle EPM Sr – Grupo Stefanini – Home Office

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Especialista/Consultor Oracle EPM será responsável por implementar, configurar e oferecer suporte às soluções Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Cloud para atender às necessidades de planejamento, orçamento, consolidação e reporting.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Implementação & Configuração: Implantar módulos do Oracle EPM Cloud (Planning, FCCS, PCM, Narrative Reporting).
  • Análise de Negócios: Levantar e analisar requisitos para planejamento financeiro, previsão e consolidação.
  • Desenvolvimento & Otimização: Criar e otimizar regras de negócio, formulários, relatórios e integrações usando EPM Automate e REST APIs.
  • Gestão de Dados: Integrar o EPM com sistemas ERP, automatizar cargas de dados, validar e reconciliar dados.
  • Suporte & Manutenção: Administrar ambientes, gerenciar metadados, monitorar performance e abrir chamados junto à Oracle.
  • Treinamento & Capacitação: Fornecer treinamento aos usuários e documentação para equipes internas.
  • Gestão de Projetos: Coordenar com stakeholders, acompanhar entregas e garantir o cumprimento de prazos.
  • Melhores Práticas: Oferecer recomendações baseadas na funcionalidade das aplicações.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:

  • Soluções Oracle EPM Cloud.
  • Forte entendimento de dimensionalidade, hierarquias, atributos e propriedades.
  • Experiência no design e construção de integrações automatizadas com Oracle EDM.
  • Tecnologias de integração: EPM Automate, Pipeline, scripts Batch, PowerShell.
  • Familiaridade com Jira (diferencial), SAP ERP (diferencial), AWS/Data Lake (diferencial).

Conhecimento Funcional

  • Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A), consolidação estatutária e análise de lucratividade.
  • Sólido entendimento dos processos de orçamento, forecast e reporting.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Excelente capacidade de resolução de problemas e troubleshooting.
  • Capacidade de questionar decisões técnicas e propor alternativas.
  • Capacidade de colaboração com equipes de Finanças, Operações e TI.
  • Liderança e habilidades de treinamento.

Qualificações

  • 5+ anos de experiência com Oracle EPM Cloud.
  • Certificações em módulos Oracle EPM.
  • Inglês fluente;

Informações adicionais

Atuação 100% remota.

Benefícios

title: College Research Administration Manager
description:
Join Howard University as a College Research Administration Manager – a hybrid reporting role pivotal to advancing the university’s R1 research mission. You’ll oversee research administration activities within assigned colleges, ensuring compliance, enhancing research productivity, and maintaining efficient workflows.

What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant organization culture

Basic Function

The College Research Administration Manager will handle pre‑ and post‑award responsibilities, collaborating with the Office of Research, college leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), and other stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned departments within the college for pre‑award and post‑award support. Primary reporting to the Office of Research with a dotted‑line reporting relationship to the Associate Dean for Research.

Principal Accountabilities

Pre‑Award Management

  • Guide PIs in preparing and submitting grant proposals, including budgets, narratives, and compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for grant submissions to central research offices and funding agencies.
  • Review and approve proposals for adherence to university, federal, and sponsor guidelines.

Post‑Award Management

  • Oversee grant account setups, cost distributions, and personnel appointments on awarded projects.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and university policies regarding allowable costs, effort reporting, and project amendments.
  • Monitor project budgets and expenditures, providing timely financial reports and projections.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Facilitate the preparation and submission of internal and external reports, including progress, compliance, and financial reports.
  • Collaborate with university compliance offices to address regulatory requirements and audit findings.

Training and Development

  • Conduct training sessions for PIs, departmental staff, and other stakeholders on research administration policies and systems.
  • Participate in university‑wide discussions on process improvement and best practices in research administration.

Collaboration and Oversight

  • Work with the Associate Dean for Research to align daily operations with college priorities.
  • Maintain active collaboration with the Office of Research to ensure consistent training, compliance, and professional development across colleges.
  • Act as a resource for faculty and staff in navigating research administration challenges.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in effective multitasking in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment with a high degree of accuracy and organization.
  • Strong organizational and time‑management skills with exceptional attention to detail; ability to thrive in a busy, high‑volume, and deadline‑driven work team environment that requires coordination of multiple activities.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non‑specialist audiences and serving as liaisons between granting agencies, university administration, and principal investigators.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA, BBA, or BS in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related fields and 5 years of professional experience in research administration.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations governing sponsored research, including Uniform Guidance and FAR clauses.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non‑specialist audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross‑functional, fast‑paced environment.
  • Proficiency in research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday).

Note: This position description is not a contract for employment. The university reserves the right to revise this position description at any time.

title: Pessoa Nutricionista
description:
Sobre a CBO

Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo.

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, e buscamos criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e seguro para todas e todos. Temos como estratégia a contratação de pessoas com deficiência e outros públicos diversos, como mulheres, negros, e o público LGBTQIA+.

Descrição da Resumida

Nesse papel, você será responsável por apoiar a operação marítima garantindo que as equipes embarcadas tenham condições seguras de trabalho, atuando em toda a cadeia de prevenção, controle e resposta a emergências.

Principais Atividades

  • Atuar como Responsável Técnica (RT) da companhia, representando a empresa junto ao CRN, Anvisa e demais órgãos reguladores.
  • Elaborar e atualizar manuals, POPs, fluxos, procedimentos e políticas de segurança alimentar e sanitária para toda a frota.
  • Realizar auditorias sanitárias internas a bordo das embarcações, registrando evidências, não conformidades e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Acompanhar auditorias sanitárias de clientes e autoridades , garantindo conformidade e suporte técnico.
  • Desenvolver e conduzir treinamentos e capacitações (onshore e offshore) sobre Boas Práticas, higiene, manipulação de alimentos e padrões sanitários.
  • Participar da implementação do projeto “Bordo Digital” , transformando checklists, formulários e registros técnicos em processos digitais.
  • Realizar análise e tratamento de não conformidades , incluindo elaboração de relatórios, definição de planos de ação e acompanhamento das tratativas.
  • Monitorar indicadores de segurança sanitária (KPIs) , avaliando desempenho, tendências e necessidades de ajuste.
  • Acompanhar e supervisionar a consultoria especializada, garantindo execução de cronogramas, inspeções e manuais de higienização.
  • Apoiar a operação e as equipes de bordo na implementação e manutenção dos padrões sanitários exigidos por normas, clientes e legislação .
  • Contribuir para a cultura de Qualidade, Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente , fortalecendo práticas operacionais seguras e conformes.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Nutrição com CRN ativo;
  • Experiência em segurança alimentar , Boas Práticas de Manipulação e inspeções sanitárias;
  • Vivência com auditorias internas e externas , elaboração de POPs, manuais e procedimentos sanitários;
  • Capacidade de conduzir treinamentos técnicos e orientar equipes operacionais;
  • Disponibilidade para visitas periódicas às embarcações e acompanhamento das rotinas de bordo;
  • Experiência com análise e tratativas de não conformidades , elaboração de relatórios e planos de ação.

Diferenciais

  • Atuação com operações marítimas/offshore , hotelaria marítima ou estaleiros;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais, gestão de indicadores (KPIs) e transformação digital de processos;
  • Experiência com gestão de fornecedores e controle sanitário de rancho;
  • Participação em auditorias sanitárias.
  • Carteira de Motorista (CNH B)

O que oferecemos para você

  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano de Previdência Privada
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Acesso ilimitado a plataforma Psicologia Viva

We are Equinix

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, operating over 260 data centers across the globe. Digital leaders harness Equinix’s trusted platform to bring together and interconnect foundational infrastructure at software speed. Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners and possibilities to scale with agility, speed the launch of digital services, deliver world‑class experiences and multiply their value, while supporting their sustainability goals.

Job Summary

The Interconnection Sales Specialist (ICSS) is responsible for driving digital revenue growth by accelerating Fabric, Fabric Cloud Router and Network Edge, and platform adoption across new and existing accounts. This role involves collaborating with cross‑functional teams, including Sales Account Executives, Solution Architects and Technical Account Managers to deliver the full value of Equinix’s digital services portfolio.

Responsibilities

Product Solutions Expertise

  • Be a digital product and services expert. Share knowledge of industry best practices, our digital service product offerings, and their benefits to customers.
  • Support building digital expertise and new products growth across field sales. Partner with Sales Account Executives on digital customer fit, pitch, personas, use cases, common pain points, potential competitors, and how to handle objections.
  • Actively maintain and grow expertise in leading transformational technology concepts and methodologies.

Build Customer Relationships

  • Work as a business partner with account teams to develop digital pursuit strategies with customers and partners.
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders in assigned accounts, prospects, and partners.
  • Contribute to quarterly business reviews with customers to identify and develop new digital selling opportunities.

Territory and Account Planning

  • Drive digital prospecting and account growth within existing accounts or new logos with Sales Account Executive.
  • Partner with Account Executives to identify, qualify, prioritize, and execute digital services strategies for short‑ and long‑term pursuit to achieve assigned sales objectives.
  • Analyze customer data and make recommendations on how to maximize digital services solutions within assigned territory or account segmentation.

Product Solution Selling

  • Work with Account Executives to identify customers’ business needs, challenges and technical requirements and match to Equinix solutions.
  • Work closely with Solutions Architects to perform presales feasibility assessments to ensure that digital solutions meet the customer requirements.
  • Define value metrics within the prospects/customers and deliver value assessments.
  • Engage and influence key decision makers within client base.
  • Facilitate resources necessary to further the sales cycle such as Solution Architects, Technical Account Managers, Product, Customer Success, Marketing etc.
  • Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales objectives and revenue quota, constantly working towards team, monthly & quarterly KPI metrics such as pipeline build, revenue attainment, digital bookings and opportunities development.

Pipeline Management

  • Prioritize list of accounts/prospects for short and long‑term pursuit to achieve assigned sales objectives.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to management such as forecasting and opportunity status.
  • Work with Marketing, Channel and Business Development to support the creation and running of campaigns to generate additional pipeline.

Negotiation

  • Work with Sales Account Executive to drive quoting, negotiating, and closing of digital services sales.
  • Support the Account Executive with digital services contracts and serve as a liaison to the legal team.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Language: Advanced/fluent English.
  • Experience: Solid experience in selling enterprise and cloud solutions; selling infrastructure‑as‑a‑service; technical sales and account management.
  • Strong knowledge of business challenges facing enterprise executives that are driving digital transformation use case adoption.

Skills And Attributes

  • Passionate about infrastructure, interconnection, and the future of technology and software‑as‑a‑service.
  • Digitally savvy and strong sales management background.
  • Excellent relationship building skills with demonstrated ability to build meaningful relationships with Equinix customers, prospects, and internal colleagues.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross‑functional teams.

Encorajamos que todas as pessoas interessadas se candidatem a essa vaga, independente de gênero, idade, raça, etnia, cor, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, religião e deficiência.

description:
Subsurface Data Management Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Join Aramco as a Subsurface Data Management Specialist and relocate permanently to Saudi Arabia with a full-time expatriate family relocation package.

Overview

We are seeking a Subsurface Data Management Specialist to join the Unconventional Resources Data Management & Digital Solutions Division (URDM & DSD) within the Unconventional Resources (UR) organization. URDM & DSD provides daily data support to all business departments and entities under the Unconventional Resources admin area, underpinning business continuity and operational activities crucial to the organization. The division offers services such as data governance and compliance, data discovery, preparation, validation, and packaging, as well as managing and supporting data in corporate repositories. It also oversees data quality management, synchronizes data from the corporate repository to application databases, handles legacy data cleanup and archiving, and facilitates the delivery and packaging of data to external partners.

Your primary role is to proactively manage and protect UR subsurface data (Petroleum Engineering and Geoscience) in official repositories by following corporate guidelines and industry best practices to positively impact UR business performance and mitigate risks. You will also ensure the accuracy, integrity, and accessibility of UR subsurface data, working closely with stakeholders to identify and address data-related issues and opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership and expertise in data management to support UR Subsurface operations.
  • Assess and implement technical data strategies that govern UR Subsurface data and establish clear guidelines to ensure data security, quality, and accessibility throughout its lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with corporate stakeholders to gather user requirements and recommend data management solutions, participating in data modeling design, project scoping, and specifications, as well as testing and acceptance.
  • Ensure that comprehensive metadata standards, business rules, and clear roles and responsibilities are consistently maintained and updated across all UR data domains.
  • Develop and propose data-related policies, oversee their implementation once approved, and identify and manage risks associated with sensitive information.
  • Lead complex data management projects, provide central direction and oversight, and coordinate with cross-functional teams to implement solutions, track progress, and generate performance reports.
  • Provide guidance on data quality assurance and control, driving initiatives to enhance data integrity and usability.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the current data management environment, develop and implement effective solutions, and create informative reports that include in-depth analysis and visualizations to support data‑driven decision making.
  • Mentor and develop the skills of young professional team members, sharing knowledge and expertise to upskill them in Data Management best practices and processes, and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT. An advanced degree is highly preferred.
  • 12‑15 years of experience in the oil and gas industry, including at least 10 years focused on upstream subsurface data management. Experience in IT project management is highly preferred.
  • Strong computer and database skills, including proficiency in SQL, and extensive experience with oil and gas applications and enterprise systems.
  • High level of knowledge in upstream domain data, including unconventional resources, and ability to develop and apply cross‑disciplinary processes that support data management best practice.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced environment and prioritize multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Professional data management certification (e.g., CDMP) is highly desirable.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry, one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhancing Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generational view of the future, born of our nine decades of experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. Our responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world and among the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Working environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector‑specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

  • Alinhar logística e recebimento com a unidade hospitalar/canteiro, respeitando horários, regras de acesso e áreas críticas.
  • Tratar divergências, não conformidades e devoluções com fornecedor e solicitante, registrando causa e correção.

Qualificações

  • Experiência prévia em compras/suprimentos para obras ou manutenção predial; experiência em ambiente hospitalar é desejável.

description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.

  • Mentor others: guide mid‑level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post‑mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event‑driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands‑on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client‑facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi‑cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

Department: Events & Entertainment

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. title: Analista Administrativo Júnior
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco? Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver atividades com orientações frequentes;
  • Desempenhar tarefas padronizadas que exigem aplicação de técnicas básicas;
  • Planejar as atividades com intuito de obter o melhor resultado;
  • Acompanhar indicadores da área;
  • Elaborar relatórios, planilhas e gráficos da área, compilando dados para acompanhamento sob orientação;
  • Preencher e emitir documentos e solicitações internas da área, de acordo com normas e critérios definidos, encaminhando às áreas e pessoas envolvidas;
  • Manter atualizados controles administrativos de sua área de atuação, desenvolvendo estudos e efetuando levantamentos, análises, programações, conferências e cálculos na realização de atividades administrativas;
  • Prestar atendimento a clientes e fornecedores, solucionando dúvidas, fornecendo informações e orientações ou direcionando às pessoas indicadas;
  • Realizar atividades e apoiar em todos os subsistemas de sua área;
  • Administrar serviços através do sistema integrado;
  • Disseminar informações sobre políticas e procedimentos aos profissionais da área, zelando por seu cumprimento;
  • Prestar atendimento a clientes e fornecedores, solucionando dúvidas, fornecendo informações e orientações ou direcionando às pessoas indicadas;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de saúde, segurança do trabalho e utilizar adequadamente equipamentos de proteção individual e coletiva;

  • Comprometer-se com as áreas: Gestão da Qualidade, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho;

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or related field.

  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client‑facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have

  • Postgraduate or Master's degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi‑cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Job Purpose

The Collections Coordinator is responsible for ensuring timely collection of accounts receivable by reconciling customer accounts and resolving payment issues. This role focuses on maintaining low outstanding receivables, adhering to established processes and procedures, and building strong internal and external relationships to support a high‑quality customer experience.

Payment Processing

  • Process electronic payments, including ACH, wire transfers, credit cards, and checks.

Process & Procedure Compliance

  • Verify that all transactions comply with company policies and internal controls.

Accounts Receivable Management

  • Manage daily collections activities to reduce outstanding receivables.
  • Monitor and maintain assigned customer accounts to ensure timely payment.
  • Develop and negotiate effective payment plans with customers.
  • Perform account reconciliations and resolve billing discrepancies.

Reporting & Communication

  • Prepare and maintain accurate daily and monthly AR reports.
  • Update the AR Manager on account status, reconciliations, risks, and resolved issues.
  • Ensure daily and monthly collection targets are met or exceeded.

Internal & External Communication

  • Communicate professionally and effectively with internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Build strong working relationships with sales teams and department leaders.
  • Coordinate with external collection agencies to maximize recovery outcomes.
  • Respond promptly to legal notices and collection‑related inquiries.

Professional Qualifications

  • Proven experience in accounts receivable and collections.

  • Strong analytical, reconciliation, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.

Personal Attributes

  • Detail‑oriented with strong deadline management skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication abilities.
  • Collaborative team player with a professional and ethical approach.
  • Level‑headed problem solver with a customer‑focused mindset.
  • Highly organized and responsible.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with external collection agencies.
  • Familiarity with AR reporting and performance metrics.
  • Experience in high‑volume or fast‑paced finance environments.

Sobre o Hospital

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais são distribuídos os serviços de emergência, Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal, maternidade, clínica médica, cirurgia‑geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves em pacientes queimados. A Unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos e visa absorver demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para casos de risco iminente de morte ou necessidade de cirurgia urgente.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

Realizar testes de aceitação em fábrica e due‑diligence dos fornecedores, visitar as obras prestando apoio técnico às áreas de projetos e manutenção.

  • Interagir constantemente durante a etapa de construção com as áreas de Meio Ambiente e Fundiário para analisar e validar possíveis alterações de traçados apresentando impactos e buscando as melhores soluções para os desvios, quando necessário.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.

Coordenação e Realização de Reuniões

Análise de Dados

Requisitos e qualificações

1. Gestão de Projetos e Metodologias

  • Metodologias de Gerenciamento de Projetos*: Conhecimento aprofundado e experiência prática em metodologias como PMBOK (PMI), Agile (Scrum, Kanban) e/ou Waterfall.
  • Planejamento e Execução*: Habilidade em elaborar cronogramas, orçamentos, planos de recursos e planos de comunicação. Experiência na execução e acompanhamento de projetos, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e escopo.

  • Ferramentas de Gerenciamento de Projetos*: Proficiência em softwares como Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana, Trello ou equivalentes.

2. Infraestrutura de Rede Wi‑Fi

  • Conceitos de Redes Wireless*: Domínio de padrões Wi‑Fi (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax), frequências (2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, 6 GHz), canais e tecnologias MIMO/MU‑MIMO.
  • Arquitetura e Projeto de Redes Wi‑Fi*: Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, design de topologias de rede, planejamento de cobertura (site surveys, heatmaps) e capacidade.
  • Implementação e Configuração*: Habilidade na instalação física e configuração lógica de Access Points (APs), Controladores Wireless (WLCs) e sistemas de gerenciamento de rede sem fio.
  • Otimização e Troubleshooting*: Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas de desempenho, conectividade e segurança em redes Wi‑Fi. Otimização de redes para alta densidade e performance.
  • Segurança de Redes Wireless*: Conhecimento em protocolos de segurança (WPA2/3, 802.1X, EAP), autenticação, criptografia e políticas de acesso (Guest Access, NAC).

3. Conhecimento Específico em Tecnologias Cisco

  • Equipamentos Cisco Wi‑Fi*: Experiência comprovada com Access Points Cisco (Catalyst, Aironet series), Controladores Wireless Cisco (Cisco Catalyst 9800 Series Wireless Controllers) e Cisco DNA Center.
  • Configuração e Gerenciamento Cisco*: Proficiência na configuração e gerenciamento de dispositivos Cisco via CLI, GUI e APIs.
  • Cisco Prime Infrastructure / DNA Center*: Familiaridade com as plataformas de gerenciamento de rede da Cisco para monitoramento, automação e provisionamento.
  • Certificações Cisco (Diferencial)*:
  • CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) Enterprise*: Demonstra conhecimento fundamental em redes corporativas.
  • CCNP Enterprise (ou certificações equivalentes focadas em Wireless)*: Para um nível mais avançado de design e troubleshooting.

4. Conhecimentos Complementares de Rede

  • Fundamentos de Redes IP*: TCP/IP, VLANs, Roteamento (estático/dinâmico), Switching (Layer 2/Layer 3).
  • Serviços de Rede*: DNS, DHCP, RADIUS, NTP.
  • Monitoramento de Rede*: Utilização de ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de tráfego de rede (Wireshark, ferramentas de SNMP).

Sobre a vaga

In M. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem‑estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoa é valorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem!

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, garantindo nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.

Nossa atuação e cultura

Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos. Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo onde todos são reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

Responsável por liderar e desenvolver a estratégia comercial para clientes nacionais, com foco no crescimento de receita, fortalecimento de relacionamento com contas estratégicas e expansão da presença da empresa no mercado brasileiro a partir da base no Rio de Janeiro.

Em 1961 foi fundado o Banco Sofisa, em uma jornada de transformação, adaptação e principalmente inovação.
